harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Installed a root crontab entry on node1 that runs /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified functionally by manual invocation, then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id/state, rebooted node1 safely, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified cron service, crontab entry, and log file all recovered intact.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance script and confirmed crond active on node1 (RHEL 7.9)
Checked existing root crontab (none present)
Added crontab entry: 15 02 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1
Verified crontab entry persisted via `sudo crontab -l -u root`
Manually ran the maintenance command to confirm output appends correctly to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, crond status, crontab contents, log file presence
Issued safe reboot (`shutdown -r now` backgrounded) on node1; connection dropped confirming acknowledgment before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Captured post-restart boot_id, confirming it differs from baseline (new boot)
Re-verified crond active, crontab entry present, and log file with prior content intact after restart

evidence.requirement: Script exists and cron/log mechanism functions correctly
evidence.summary: Confirmed /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance exists and executable; manual run appended timestamped output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log

evidence.requirement: Crontab entry installed for daily 02:15 run with log retention
evidence.summary: No prior root crontab existed; added and verified entry '15 02 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'
Captured boot_id fe422859-bfe7-4eb4-819b-e09864f3ca60, uptime 139s, crond active, crontab entry present, log file present
shutdown -r now issued in background; command returned/connection closed confirming the restart was accepted and executing

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Exec unreachable during reboot, then succeeded again; new boot_id ee855acb-6c78-44fd-bae4-b9b069778861 (different from baseline) with uptime 9s proves an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of cron job, crontab, and log data on node1
evidence.summary: After restart, crond active, crontab entry for inventory-maintenance still present, and /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log retained its prior content
